Fantastic value tasty sushi
Nov 2023 • Friends
We were a group of five who booked a table last min on Sat night that they managed to fit us in. The menu is a little overwhelming as there is so much choice. We opted for a selection of sushi, tempura dishes with edamane beans. All was super tasty and fresh, perfect sharing as a group with a few tiger beers on tap. Bill worked out less than £10 each for decent amount of food and a couple of drinks each.

Best sushi in Hanoi (so far...)
Apr 2017 • Solo
The staff are very nice and genuine in this place. The sushi is of great quality and the restaurant is always busy so you can be guaranteed that their product is fresh. Prices reflect the quality of the food, slightly more expensive than some other establishments in the area however their food does not match up - you get what you pay for. Menu also contains a good variety of dishes. Definitely worth a visit.

Good sushi, nice place
Aug 2015
This restaurant is located right in the Syrena Shopping Center on the ground floor. It's a large restaurant with two separate dining areas. Prices are quite reasonable and the quality of the sushi is good. I had the tekka maki set dinner, which came with a generous portion of tuna, sushi rice, soup and salads, and fruit was served as dessert. It was a good value, service was fine and I'd come back to eat here again.

Does the job.
Sep 2014 • Solo
There's a abundance of Japanese options around this area, and I wouldn't say this is my favorite.

But, it's not bad either. Mostly I prefer the others as this is located in a mini-mall which gives it a certain mally-feeling. Food is what you expect. Good deals on set lunches, basic variety of sushis, a touch of yakitory, and basic japanese fare.

AC is excellent, and the premise is spotless. Point for that.
